title: CARBD-KO: A CONTEXTUALLY ANNOTATED REVIEW BENCHMARK DATASET FOR ASPECT-LEVEL SENTIMENT CLASSIFICATION IN KOREAN

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on predicting aspect-specific polarities versus aspect-agnostic polarities to evaluate the model's over-reliance on overall sentence context (contextualization/hallucination) rather than the localized aspect.

Implementing a peer review stage where multiple annotators are divided into groups to independently label randomly shuffled subsets of the dataset, ensuring consistency and minimizing human subjectivity in sentiment assignments.
